summary: Nexera Technologies Ltd (formerly Jeffs' Brands Ltd), an Israeli foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K on August 19, 2026. The filing discloses an adjustment to the exercise price of three series of warrants—Series A Warrants issued January 29, 2024, June 2026 PIPE Warrants, and June 2026 Note Warrant—effective August 18, 2026, resetting the exercise price per ordinary share to $2.215928. No other modifications were made. This is a routine anti-dilution warrant adjustment, not a special situation. The filing is incorporated by reference into several Form F-3 and Form S-8 registration statements, but no strategic event is announced. Watch for future filings if the adjustment signals dilution or financing stress.
